description.zh-CN: 把一个核心想法转成适合不同平台语境的短内容、钩子、变体与人工发布清单。
description.en-US: Turn one core idea into platform-aware short content, hooks, variants, and a manual publishing checklist.

capabilities.zh-CN: 建立内容支柱与形式矩阵
为目标平台写钩子与完整短内容
capabilities.en-US: Write hooks and complete platform-aware posts

capabilities.zh-CN: 将长内容拆成多个不重复的短内容
capabilities.en-US: Repurpose long-form work into distinct short pieces

examples.zh-CN: 把这篇文章改成小红书和公众号短帖，各写一版。
examples.en-US: Adapt this article into distinct short posts for two platforms.

examples.zh-CN: 围绕三个内容支柱做一个选题矩阵。
examples.en-US: Build an idea matrix around three content pillars.

examples.zh-CN: 给这个观点写五个真实、不夸张的开头。
examples.en-US: Write five honest, non-hyped hooks for this idea.

boundary.zh-CN: 不自动发布、私信、抓取或操作平台账户；平台规则与最佳实践会变化，发布前需由用户核验并人工确认。
boundary.en-US: Never publishes, messages, scrapes, or operates platform accounts; platform rules and best practices change, so users verify and manually approve before posting.

sources.modifications: Retained audience, goal, voice, content pillars, hooks, repurposing, calendar, and review concepts; removed platform automation, engagement quotas, scraping, and claims about fixed algorithms.
sources.securityReviewNotes: No account actions or live platform assumptions remain. Format guidance is treated as a hypothesis to verify.

sources.modifications: Retained input gathering, evidence-aware planning, full-draft writing, and user-led iteration; removed auto-start and tool-specific interaction requirements.
sources.securityReviewNotes: Posting and research are not automated; unsupported claims require user evidence or current verification.

sources.modifications: Retained pillar-by-format ideation across actionable, motivational, analytical, contrarian, observational, comparison, future, and list formats; removed interactive widgets and filesystem-specific behavior.
sources.securityReviewNotes: Only a plain Markdown planning matrix is produced. No platform action is taken.
